title: Brick stables behind 2001 and 2009 Prairie
items: The building behind 2001 Prairie, on the corner of 20th Street and the alley, now stands as a two-storey brick stable 16 m long on the outline the 1911 fire-insurance map draws, set back from both the street and the alley as the map shows, with windows onto 20th Street.

The stable behind the Meyer house at 2009 Prairie now stands on the alley line, 13.9 m deep by 8.5 m along the alley, with the one window the map marks on its alley wall and the house's one-storey back range against its yard side.
